description: Inspect DOS game binaries, review distribution files and plan a native port from evidence.

defaultPrompt: Analyze this DOS game and show me the first native subsystem to port.
Review this game folder and identify which files a native build needs.
Show the DOS, BIOS and hardware calls in this executable with their offsets.
interface.longDescription: Analyze a DOS game folder, ZIP or executable. Locate platform calls in 16-bit code, identify files to retain or review, create a filtered copy, and select a testable first step for a native port.

name: dos-port-workbench
